pages.text: All environment bonuses are optional and off by default: night energy+20 percent; full-moon wave damage+10 percent; thunder chains to at most2 nearby enemies for25 percent damage; End domain visuals+25 percent; doubled Nether decay; beacon beam repairs an unbroken shield; quiet nearby amethyst resonance; falling wave attacks gain at most50 percent damage. No dimension travel or remote chunk loading is added.
